NETWORKING · DOCUMENTED BUILD

Local Reverse Proxy

Name-based access to applications inside the home network.

Nginx Proxy ManagerDNSLAN

System at a glance

Client hostname→Local DNS→Nginx Proxy Manager→LAN application

What I built

  • Moved toward LAN-only application access with Nginx Proxy Manager.
  • Configured DNS records to direct hostnames to a private reverse-proxy address.
  • Investigated name-resolution and browser connection errors while bringing the local route online.

Troubleshooting notes

Wrong DNS target

A hostname resolved to 0.0.0.0. The A record was corrected to the intended LAN proxy address.

QUIC / connection errors

Checked name resolution and the intended local route while troubleshooting browser errors. The final browser configuration was not recorded.

What I learned

  • A reverse-proxy rule cannot help if DNS sends the client to the wrong address.
  • Check hostname resolution before changing application settings.
Documentation compiled from my project notes and shared troubleshooting history. Commands, final configuration files, and screenshots will be added as they are verified. The diagram is a simplified project overview.
